topic: Platypus: a mammal that lays eggs and can sense tiny electric signals from prey with its bill.

episode.title: Platypus: The Electric-Sensing Egg Layer!

shots.narration: Did you know this bill can sense tiny electric signals?
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D animated Australian creek, close view of a cute, realistic platypus at the water's surface, no text.
shots.action: The platypus dips its broad bill underwater.
shots.mood: Sunny water sparkles around an intriguing close-up.

shots.narration: Meet the platypus, a mammal with an extraordinary superpower!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, sunny creek bank with eucalyptus trees, Kiko in his green safari hat beside hovering emerald-green Pip, platypus in the creek.
shots.action: Kiko raises his big binoculars toward the platypus.
shots.mood: Bright green foliage and eager exploration.

shots.narration: [surprised] But how can it find food in cloudy water?
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, creek-side view beside Kiko's khaki vest, brown silty water obscuring the creek bottom.
shots.action: Kiko peers into the cloudy creek.

shots.narration: Its bill senses tiny electric signals from prey.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, realistic underwater creek close-up, platypus bill above a silty bottom, soft natural light, no glowing powers or graphics.
shots.action: The platypus sweeps its bill above the creek bed.
shots.mood: Quiet concentration in softly clouded water.

shots.narration: That helps it locate food hidden from sight.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, underwater close-up of the same platypus over muddy sediment, no prey visible.
shots.action: The platypus presses its bill into the soft sediment.
shots.mood: A gentle discovery with drifting flecks of silt.

shots.narration: [excited] Cloudy water is no match for that amazing bill!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, sunny creek bank, Kiko beside Pip with the platypus visible near the surface behind them.
shots.mood: Delighted smiles and sparkling creek reflections.

shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, naturalistic cutaway view inside a sheltered creek-bank nesting burrow, a female platypus curled beside small leathery eggs on dry plant bedding.
shots.action: The platypus gently curls around her eggs.
shots.mood: Cozy earth tones and soft, peaceful lighting.

shots.narration: An egg-laying mammal with an electric-sensing bill: wonderfully unusual!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, wide sunny creek bank, Kiko and ruby-throated Pip watching the platypus swim below them.
shots.action: Kiko spreads his arms in amazement.
shots.mood: Joyful wonder in a bright natural landscape.

shots.narration: [whispers] Next, sticky toes! Can you guess which animal we're discovering?
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, textured eucalyptus trunk beside the creek, Kiko and hovering Pip looking upward, no other animal visible.
shots.action: Kiko points up the tree trunk.
shots.mood: Playful mystery beneath a sunlit leafy canopy.

episode.endHook: Which animal can climb using sticky toes? Guess our next discovery!
episode.description: Kiko and Pip discover a platypus with an extraordinary bill! Explore how this egg-laying mammal senses tiny electric signals from prey, even in cloudy water.
